currency.source: USD/INR about 95.95 on 16 September 2026 (longforecast.com, 'USD to INR today'); set to the day's rate before use

India.source: Senior developer and architect bands for 2026: senior developers about 18 to 45 lakh a year (futurense.com, August 2026); software architects 28.5 to 38.8 lakh (AmbitionBox via wisemonk.io, August 2026)

United States.source: BLS OEWS May 2025, Software Developers, SOC 15-1252: median 135,980 USD; quartile band 105,210 to 171,980 USD (as republished by hyring.com)

loaded_cost_factor.source: assumption: employer overheads over salary; set to your own figure

prices_usd_per_mtok.source: Anthropic list prices per million tokens, Opus, Sonnet and Haiku tiers, as published mid-2026 (fast.io and finout.io summaries of the official page); cache reads at one tenth of input. Check anthropic.com/pricing for the models you use.

chars_per_token.source: Anthropic's tokenizer averages about one token per four characters (lmmarketcap.com)

productivity_time_ratio.source: Time with AI over time without. 0.44: Peng et al. 2023, Copilot RCT, a greenfield task done 55.8% faster (161 to 71 minutes). 1.19: METR RCT, July 2025, experienced developers on their own mature repositories, 19% slower. 0.75 is an assumption between the two; METR notes developers in 2026 are likely faster than its early-2025 estimate.

usage.source: assumption: drafts produced per final token, input tokens read per output token, model tier, and share of input served from the prompt cache

writing.source: assumption: finished technical prose per writer-day; set to your own figure

assets.source: assumption: hours per finished figure or poster image above the size threshold; set to your own figure

as_built.ai_spend_source: set to your actual AI spend: subscriptions and API bills over the period
as_built.source: assumption: hours worked on a day with at least one commit; set to your own figure
